findings.title: Require exact account-proof observation and expiry when linking quote evidence
findings.trigger: AccountEvidence uses observedAt101/expiresAt1100 while the referenced account_session contains observedAt100/expiresAt1000; all provider/account/generation/session IDs and snapshots otherwise agree.
findings.actual: insertQuoteProof succeeds. validateQuoteProof only bounds accountPayload.observedAt relative to quote.createdAt and quote expiry relative to account proof; it never requires evidence.observedAt/expiresAt equal the referenced account proof.
findings.expected: Reject the mismatched evidence before inserting a link and propagate failure to the outer transaction. Preserve exact account observation/expiry pinned by the proof.
findings.evidence: Isolated variation of existing v3 test expects rejection and fails because no error is thrown, sqlite.test.ts559 in preserved variant copy.
findings.required_followup: Compare pinned AccountEvidence observedAt/expiresAt to the referenced account_session fields; preserve regression proving mismatched time association rejects and all aggregate writes roll back.

findings.title: Bound execution-proof expiry by the referenced worker account session
findings.trigger: execution_session observedAt300/expiresAt700 references a worker account_session observedAt300/expiresAt350; quote and capability remain valid through700 or later.
findings.actual: insertExecutionProof succeeds because validation checks only observedAt against workerPayload.expiresAt and bounds execution expiry by quote/capability, omitting worker account expiry.
findings.expected: Require payload.expiresAt <= workerPayload.expiresAt and reject/roll back a link extending beyond the authenticated worker observation validity.
findings.evidence: Isolated variation of existing execution association test expects rejection and fails because no error is thrown, sqlite.test.ts602 in preserved variant copy.
findings.required_followup: Add worker-session expiry bound and preserve a focused regression covering attempted overlong execution proof plus aggregate rollback.

findings.title: Match worker SDK and adapter provenance to the pinned quote session
findings.trigger: A worker account_session and execution_session agree with one another but use sdkVersion/sdkSourceHash/adapterVersion different from the quote-time session, while retaining the same model and capability snapshot.
findings.actual: validateExecutionProof compares workerPayload.session to payload.session but never compares their SDK/adapter version/hash fields with quotePayload.session. The mismatch is not part of any rejection condition.
findings.expected: Enforce frozen SDK/adapter provenance agreement between quote session and worker execution session, while allowing their local sessionId/role to differ. Reject mismatched links and propagate aggregate rollback.
findings.evidence: Static inspection of the complete validateExecutionProof comparison at sqlite.ts157; no additional probe at reserve.
findings.required_followup: Compare sdkVersion, sdkSourceHash and adapterVersion between execution/worker and pinned quote session; preserve one minimal mismatch rejection/rollback regression when authorized.
